metadata.title: Tyler Shough throws for 278 yards in loss
metadata.description: Tyler Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards, a touchdown, and a pick in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He was the Saints' leading rusher with seven yards on three carries.
metadata.analysis: Shough didn't have a terrible game, all things considered. He was accurate, put up decent yardage, but was just held out of the end zone. Obviously, that's a big part of fantasy football, but it's also important to remember that because the Saints had no running game, it made things a little tougher for Shough in the passing game.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Tosses one TD in Paris
metadata.description: Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers. He added seven rushing yards on three carries.
metadata.analysis: With the Saints' ground game getting absolutely nowhere -- Shough actually led the team in rushing yards -- the second-year QB had to air it out frequently once again, but the volume didn't result in much production. Shough will head into a Week 8 bye averaging 39 pass attempts a game -- the fourth-highest mark in the league behind Matthew Stafford, Dak Prescott and Bryce Young -- to go along with a 13:6 TD:INT and 1,721 passing yards.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Faces Tough Test After Productive Week 6
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns, adding five carries for 32 yards and another score in Week 6's 34-27 win over the Giants. His passing yardage was his second-lowest total of the season, potentially due in part to playing through two broken bones in his non-throwing hand. After averaging 45.0 pass attempts per game through his first four contests, Shough has averaged just 27.5 over the last two weeks. His five rushing attempts against the Giants were also his second-most of the season, and the Saints are now 2-0 when he records at least five carries. He faces a Steelers defense allowing just 204.3 passing yards and one passing touchdown per game. The difficult matchup puts Shough at QB15 in RotoBaller's rankings this week.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough throws three touchdowns Sunday
metadata.description: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
metadata.analysis: Shough continues to play through broken bones in his non-throwing hand. After a slow start in the first quarter, he had a solid afternoon the rest of the game. He also added another touchdown on the ground. He'll face the Steelers next week.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Four TDs in Week 6 win
metadata.description: Shough completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 34-27 win over the Giants. He added 32 yards and a TD on five carries.
metadata.analysis: While he didn't produce much yardage, Shough kept the Saints' offense humming, connecting with Bryce Lance, Alvin Kamara and Chris Olave for scores through the air while adding a one-yard touchdown on the ground in the third quarter. Shough has been playing through a couple broken bones in his non-throwing hand, which could help explain why he has just 242 passing yards over the last two weeks, but the second-year QB showed he can be plenty productive despite the injury. Shough will take a 12:5 TD:INT through six games into a Week 7 tilt against the Steelers in Paris.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Totals Four Touchdowns In Win Over Giants
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough completed 16 out of 30 passing attempts (53.3%) for 144 yards and three touchdown passes, and added five carries for 32 yards and an additional score in a 34-27 win over the New York Giants in Week 6. While Shough didn't throw for many yards or complete a high percentage of his passes, he lived in the end zone against the Giants. It was a big bounce-back effort for Shough, who is reportedly playing through two broken bones in his non-throwing hand, after he threw for just 96 yards, zero touchdowns, and two interceptions in a 23-13 loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 5. In Week 6, Shough connected on touchdown passes with running back Alvin Kamara, wide receiver Chris Olave, and wide receiver Bryce Lance. Shough continues to be productive and currently ranks in the top 10 in the NFL in passing yards (1,143) and touchdown passes (12).

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Playing through broken bones in hand
metadata.description: Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
metadata.analysis: Shough has been listed with a left hand injury the past two weeks, but the extent wasn't known until Schefter's report Sunday morning. He had his least productive performance of the season last Sunday versus the Vikings' ferocious defense, when he completed 16 of 25 passes for just 96 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions. Shough will aim to get back on track in Week 6 against a banged-up Giants defensive unit.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Has Been Playing with Two Broken Bones in Left Hand
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough (hand) has been playing through a significant injury that includes two broken bones in his left hand, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN.com. The injury has been present for the last two weeks, but it reportedly started to really bother him last week against the Vikings, as he threw for just 96 yards, zero touchdowns, and two interceptions. He still ranks as the overall QB11 in fantasy football scoring despite last week's dud performance. Through five weeks, he has 10 total touchdowns, although he also has eight interceptions. Equally important as Shough's fantasy production is the fact that he has been able to support Chris Olave, Devaughn Vele, and Juwan Johnson outperforming their own expectations this season.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Looks to Bounce Back Against Giants
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough completed 16-of-25 pass attempts for just 96 yards and two interceptions in Week 5's loss to the Vikings. His 3.8 yards per attempt and 38.1 passer rating were both the worst marks of his young career, as he faced constant pressure from a relentless Vikings front that posted a 50% pressure rate. This was Shough's first game of the season without at least 252 passing yards and a touchdown. He will look to bounce back against a Giants defense allowing 199.4 passing yards per game, the seventh-fewest in the league, but surrendering the ninth-most fantasy points to opposing quarterbacks. Shough ranks as QB13 in RotoBaller's rankings this week.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Losing His Appeal as a Weekly Fantasy Starter
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough is becoming increasingly difficult to trust in standard fantasy lineups after two performances that bear little resemblance to his impressive start to 2026. His first three games produced 917 passing yards and eight touchdowns, numbers that briefly made him an appealing option for managers searching for quarterback help. That momentum has disappeared. Shough has thrown for 382 yards and one touchdown over his last two starts, with Sunday's 23-13 defeat against Minnesota representing his worst outing yet. He completed 16 of 25 passes for 96 yards and two interceptions as the Saints managed only 142 yards of total offense. New Orleans had few answers for Minnesota's defense, making it difficult to place the entire blame on its quarterback. Shough has also been dealing with a left-hand issue, although full practices Wednesday and Thursday suggest he remains on track to face the Giants in Week 6. His starting job keeps him relevant in Superflex formats. For managers in standard one-quarterback leagues, Sunday's matchup offers a chance to evaluate whether his early-season passing production is something they can reasonably expect again.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough (hand) logs another full practice Thursday
metadata.description: Tyler Shough (hand) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: The young quarterback's hand injury isn't serious and hasn't affected his participation at practice all week thus far. He should play and will be looking to bounce back on Sunday after a disappointing performance in Week 5.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough (hand) practices in full Wednesday
metadata.description: Tyler Shough (hand) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The young quarterback was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, despite still dealing with a hand issue of some kind. He should be good to go for Week 6, however, and this issue shouldn't play a big factor for fantasy managers when they weigh whether or not to start him against the Giants this week.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough playing through hand injury
metadata.description: Saints QB Tyler Shough is reportedly playing through a hand injury.
metadata.analysis: Saints head coach Kellen Moore was asked directly whether Shough's hand is broken. "It got banged two weeks ago and he's just wearing some protective layers there," he said. It doesn't appear Shough is in danger of missing any time, but he'll need to be monitored on the injury report this week.

metadata.title: Saints Won't Say if Tyler Shough's Hand is Broken
metadata.description: When asked if quarterback Tyler Shough's left (non-throwing) hand is broken, New Orleans Saints head coach Kellen Moore was non-committal on Monday, according to Saints sideline reporter Jeff Nowak. "It got banged two weeks ago, and he's just wearing some protective layers there," Moore said. Shough got his second NFL season started out with a bang, but he has underwhelmed in each of the last two weeks in losses to the Atlanta Falcons and Minnesota Vikings. Facing one of the best defenses in the league in Minnesota on Sunday, Shough had his worst day at the offense through five games, going 16-for-25 passing for only 96 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions in a 23-13 loss. He threw for 286 yards and one touchdown in the Week 4 loss to Atlanta after throwing for eight TDs and three interceptions in the first three games of 2026. Shough did not look right against Minnesota and could be playing through a broken hand, but that should not stop him from having bounce-back potential on the QB1/2 radar in Week 6 against the New York Giants.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough struggles behind center in Week 5 loss to Vikings
metadata.description: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-25 pass attempts for 96 yards and two interceptions in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
metadata.analysis: Shough fell victim to an aggressive Minnesota defense for head coach Kellen Moore, failing to pass for at least one touchdown for the first time in five games this season. The quarterback will look to get back on track against a more generous New York Giants defense in Week 6.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Dismantled by the Vikings' Defense
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough completed 16 of his 25 pass attempts for just 96 passing yards, zero touchdowns, and two interceptions during Sunday's Week 5 win against the Minnesota Vikings. He also took a sack and was held without a rushing attempt for the first time in his career. Shough was the QB5 in fantasy football entering Sunday, so his fantasy managers were certainly disappointed to see a dud in Week 5. With that being said, a performance like this is within the range of outcomes when your team is facing the Vikings' defense. Minnesota's defensive unit is incredibly talented and well-coached, leading to results like this one. Week 5 is a huge blemish on Shough's track record, but he has his toughest matchup of the season behind him and should bounce back in Week 6 against a very uninspiring Giants squad.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Overwhelmed by Vikings in loss
metadata.description: Shough completed 16 of 25 passes for 96 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Vikings on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Shough's final line underscores the duress he was under throughout the afternoon from an aggressive Vikings defense, even as he took just one sack. Shough nevertheless was intent on getting ball out quickly, leading to him averaging just 3.8 yards per attempt. The second-year quarterback's pair of interceptions didn't lead to any Minnesota points, but they did saddle Shough with his first multi-INT tally since Week 1. Despite Sunday's stumble, Shough and the rest of his teammates on the offensive side of the ball will have a good opportunity to bounce back in a favorable Week 6 road matchup against the Giants next Sunday.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Faces Tough Week 5 Matchup Against Vikings
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough completed 30-of-48 pass attempts for 286 yards and a touchdown in Week 4's loss to the Falcons. Shough was uncomfortable in the pocket for much of the game, facing pressure on 49% of his dropbacks and getting sacked twice. The second-year quarterback also popped up on this week's injury report with a left-hand issue, though he practiced in full on both Thursday and Friday and is good to go for Week 5's game against Minnesota. He faces a Vikings defense allowing just 194.8 passing yards per game while recording a league-high 16 sacks through the first four weeks. With the tough matchup and the Saints' ongoing offensive line issues, Shough has slid down to QB18 in RotoBaller's rankings for this week.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Good to go for Week 5
metadata.description: Shough (left hand) practiced fully Friday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Emily Leiker of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.
metadata.analysis: Shough opened the week with a limited walkthrough Wednesday due to a left hand injury, but he didn't endure any restrictions Thursday and Friday and thus is good to go for Week 5. He currently ranks third in the NFL in passing yards per game with 300.8, which he's supplemented with a 9:3 TD:INT through four contests.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough (hand) upgraded to full participant Thursday
metadata.description: Tyler Shough (hand) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: New Orleans' starting quarterback was limited on Wednesday due to an injury to his non-throwing hand, but it doesn't seem to be a serious issue, as he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. He should be a full go for Week 5, which is good news for the fantasy value of Chris Olave (foot), Juwan Johnson, and Alvin Kamara (back) ahead of a tough matchup against the Vikings.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Full practice Thursday
metadata.description: Shough (left hand) practiced in full Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Shough was limited at Wednesday's walkthrough due to an injury to hie left, non-throwing hand, but it didn't impede him whatsoever one day later, indicating he's in the clear for Week 5 action. Through four games this season, he's taken advantage of a pass-heavy offense, completing 121 of 180 throws for 1,203 yards, nine touchdowns and three interceptions.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Practices in Full on Thursday
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough (hand) was limited in practice on Wednesday with a left-hand injury but upgraded to a full participant on Thursday, according to the team's official website. Shough is in the clear to suit up this Sunday at home against the Minnesota Vikings in a challenging matchup, and he should not have any physical limitations. The second-year signal-caller is the QB3 overall through the first four weeks of 2026, behind only Josh Allen and Brock Purdy. Shough leads the league in both completions (121) and attempts (180) in head coach Kellen Moore's high-tempo offense while throwing for 1,203 yards, nine touchdowns, and three interceptions to begin his sophomore campaign. The health of top receiver Chris Olave (foot) needs to be monitored going into the weekend, but as long as Olave is active, Shough should be on the QB1/2 borderline for fantasy managers. Running back Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is on Injured Reserve, and Alvin Kamara is banged up with a back injury, so the Saints could lean even more heavily on the passing attack against Minnesota.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Limited With Hand Injury on Wednesday
metadata.description: Tyler Shough (hand), the starting quarterback for the New Orleans Saints, was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a left hand issue, according to the team's injury report. However, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football noted that Shough's injury "doesn't sound concerning." The Saints are coming off of a 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons on Monday Night Football. Shough completed 30 of his 48 passes (62.5%) for 286 yards and a touchdown. Through four games in the 2026 season, Shough currently ranks third in the NFL with 1,203 passing yards, and he is tied for third in the league in touchdown passes with nine. While fantasy managers will need to keep a close eye on Shough's status the rest of the week, his availability does not seem too worrisome right now.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough (hand) limited at practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Tyler Shough (hand) was limited at New Orleans' practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Shough is a new addition to New Orleans' injury report, being listed with an injury to his non-throwing hand that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue at this point, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't be worried about it affecting his availability or performance in Week 5.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Limited with left hand issue
metadata.description: Shough was limited with a non-throwing hand injury Wednesday, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.
metadata.analysis: Shough had his left hand wrapped during Wednesday's walkthrough, but the team is not overly concerned, according to Triplett. It was a physical game Monday night as the Falcons registered 12 quarterback hits on Shough. As it stands, Shough's status is not in jeopardy for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough throws for 286 yards in loss Monday
metadata.description: Tyler Shough completed 30-of-48 passing attempts for 286 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
metadata.analysis: New Orleans had a rough game on Monday night, suffering a blowout loss at the hands of their divisional rivals at home. Shough was personally able to have an okay game, however, logging close to 300 total yards and taking good care of the ball over the course of the night. Fantasy managers probably aren't satisfied with his output in this game, but he should bounce back and return to having high value sometime within the next game or two.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Solid fantasy numbers in loss
metadata.description: Shough completed 30 of 48 passes for 286 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed twice for five yards in the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Falcons on Monday night.
metadata.analysis: Shough's final line was perfectly acceptable from a fantasy standpoint, but Monday night was a case of the numbers being much more aesthetically pleasing than the on-field results. He piled up a significant part of his production in the second half -- including a three-yard touchdown pass to Devaughn Vele with 1:13 remaining -- after the Saints already faced a sizable deficit, as he led a couple of 13-play drives in the fourth quarter when New Orleans was down by 21 and 28 points, respectively. Nevertheless, Shough generated his second interception-free performance of the last three games, and he's up to 1,203 passing yards and a 9:3 TD:INT along with 72 rushing yards and another score heading into a Week 5 home matchup against an aggressive Vikings defense on Sunday.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Set Up for Another Strong Showing Against the Falcons
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough completed 29-of-42 passes for 255 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in Week 3's 35-27 loss to the Raiders. Shough was in control of the offense for much of the game, leading the Saints to an 11-point lead midway through the third quarter. He and the offense eventually stalled, committing turnovers on all four possessions in the fourth quarter and ultimately falling short. He looks to bounce back against a Falcons defense on Monday night that is surrendering 263 passing yards per game, 29th in the league. Through the first three weeks, Shough ranks as QB3 and has another plus matchup against the Falcons. Second in the league in passing yards and with rushing upside, Shough has established himself as a weekly QB1 in fantasy.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough One of the Biggest Fantasy Success Stories to Begin the Year
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough showed flashes of elite fantasy upside after taking over as starter midway through his 2025 rookie season, and he has rewarded fantasy managers who bought in as a 2026 sleeper. Through three weeks, Shough ranks third in the league with 912 passing yards, while his eight passing touchdowns trail only Brock Purdy and Kirk Cousins, making him the fantasy QB3 to begin the year. Operating Kellen Moore's up-tempo offense, no player has seen more dropbacks or attempted more passes than Shough, and his surrounding cast, currently led by Chris Olave and tight end Juwan Johnson, should only grow stronger with 2026 first-round pick Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) nearing a return from the hamstring injury that landed him on injured reserve to begin the season. Shough is RotoBaller's QB8 ahead of a Monday night tilt with the Falcons, and he is a player who can be trusted as a long-term QB1.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough throws four touchdowns, struggles with turnovers late
metadata.description: Tyler Shough completed 29-of-42 passes for 255 yards with four touchdowns and one interception in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Shough was dealing through the first three quarters, tossing four touchdowns with two of them going to Juwan Johnson and the other two going to Noah Fant. The Saints turned the ball over four times in the fourth quarter with three of them being committed by Shough on an interception and two fumbles. He'll face the Falcons next week.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Fires four TDs in tough Week 3 loss
metadata.description: Shough completed 29 of 42 passes for 255 yards and four touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-27 loss to the Raiders. He added 36 rushing yards on his lone carry, but also lost two fumbles.
metadata.analysis: The second-year QB was dynamic once again, tossing two TDs each to tight ends Juwan Johnson and Noah Fant, but protection issues in the absence of left tackle Kelvin Banks (ankle) ending up proving costly as all four of the Saints' fourth-quarter possessions ended in turnovers, causing them to squander a 27-22 lead. Shough has thrown eight touchdowns through three games but has also given the ball away six times (three INTs and three lost fumbles), and he'll try to clean up those issues in Week 4 at home against the Falcons.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Emerging as a Weekly QB1 Option
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough completed 27-of-34 passes for 252 yards and a touchdown in Week 2's 24-17 victory over the Baltimore Ravens. Shough orchestrated the offense beautifully, adding an additional nine carries for 23 yards and another score. Through two weeks, Shough has a league-high 662 passing yards, four touchdowns, and a 68.9% completion rate, and comes in as QB5 in fantasy. He faces a Raiders defense that has allowed the 9th-fewest points to opposing quarterbacks, including just one passing touchdown while forcing three interceptions through two games. Shough is playing with plenty of confidence, and the momentum he has gained to start the season lands him as QB10 on RotoBaller's rankings for Week 3.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Is Making Himself Hard to Leave on Waivers
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough backed up his huge opener with another strong fantasy game Sunday, completing 27 of 34 passes for 252 yards and a touchdown while adding 23 yards and a score on nine carries against Baltimore. He did not need another 410-yard afternoon to get there, either. Through two weeks, Shough leads the NFL with 90 passing attempts and 662 yards, and he has now accounted for five total touchdowns. That kind of workload is getting difficult to treat as a temporary streaming situation. Las Vegas has generated plenty of pressure early this season, but RotoBaller still lists Shough as a potential Week 3 boom and has him second among quarterbacks on its waiver rankings. He is still available in more than half of Yahoo leagues. Shough should be added in 12-team formats at this point, and managers searching for a quarterback should be comfortable holding him beyond just this week's matchup.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough executes late comeback win in Week 2
metadata.description: Tyler Shough completed 27-of-34 passes for 252 yards and one touchdown in a 24-17 win over the Ravens.
metadata.analysis: Shough also added 23 rushing yards on nine carries in the win. Both of the second-year quarterback's touchdowns came in the fourth quarter to tie the game and give the Saints the lead. Shough has looked great through his first two games of the season and will look to build on these performances in a Week 3 matchup with Las Vegas.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Produces two TDs in Week 2 win
metadata.description: Shough completed 27 of 34 passes for 252 yards and a touchdown while adding 23 yards and a TD on nine carries in Sunday's 24-17 win over the Ravens.
metadata.analysis: The second-year QB had a slow start to the contest, but Shough engineered another second-half comeback for the Saints, and this one was actually successful. He hit Chris Olave for a 21-yard TD early in the fourth quarter before just getting across the goal line for a one-yard score inside the final two minutes. Shough has 662 passing yards and a 4:2 TD:INT through two games to begin the season, and he'll take plenty of confidence and momentum into a Week 3 home clash with the Raiders.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Faces Tough Week 2 Matchup Against Ravens
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough struggled in the first half of Week 1 against the Lions, completing just 10 of 22 passes for 85 yards and an interception. He found his groove in the second half and overtime, completing 25 of 34 passes for 326 yards, three touchdowns and one pick. Shough said afterward that he was "trying to be too perfect" early on against Detroit. He'll now face a tough Ravens defense in Week 2 after they allowed just 166 passing yards and one passing touchdown to Daniel Jones and the Colts in Week 1. Shough will need to do a better job limiting turnovers, and getting off to a better start will be important against Baltimore. His ability to push the ball downfield gives him strong upside, but the tough matchup does add some risk. If he can avoid the early mistakes, Shough is a high-upside QB2 this week.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough a High-Upside Waiver-Wire Target Following Explosive Week 1
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough shook off a rough first half to post a monster performance in his team's Week 1 overtime loss to the Detroit Lions, completing 35 of 56 pass attempts for 410 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions. Turnovers were an issue for Shough, as he also lost a fumble in addition to throwing the two picks. However, the 26-year-old nearly led his team all the way back from a 21-point deficit by leading touchdown drives on four of the Saints' final six possessions of the game. Shough was impressive down the stretch of the 2025 season after taking over as the Saints' QB1 in Week 9, throwing for over 1,300 yards and collecting eight total touchdowns over the team's final five games. If Week 1 is any indication, he could be in line for a year-2 breakout in 2026. Shough profiles as a must-start quarterback in two-QB formats, and he's worth targeting on the waiver wire in 12-team, single-QB fantasy leagues as well.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough electrifies late in Week 1 loss to Lions
metadata.description: Tyler Shough completed 35-of-56 pass attempts for 410 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while also rushing four times for eight yards in the Saints' 31-30 Week 1 overtime loss to the Detroit Lions.
metadata.analysis: Shough carried the New Orleans offense late in the contest after trailing 21-0 at one point, throwing three second-half touchdowns to force overtime in the Week 1 loss. The second-year signal-caller faces a stiff test in Week 2 against a tough Baltimore Ravens defense next.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough - Tops 400 yards in OT loss to Detroit
metadata.description: Shough completed 35 of 56 passes for 410 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 31-30 overtime loss to the Lions. He added eight yards on four carries and fumbled twice, losing one of them.
metadata.analysis: The second-year quarterback struggled in the first half and the Saints were facing a 21-0 deficit early in the third quarter, but Shough turned it on down the stretch as he set new career highs in attempts, completions, passing yards and passing TDs. Coach Kellen Moore gave Shough a chance to win the game in OT rather than tying it with an extra point, but rookie WR Bryce Lance couldn't bring in his throw to the back corner of the end zone for a two-point conversion. Shough will look to reduce his mistakes in Week 2 on the road against the Ravens.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Has Streaming Upside Against Detroit
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough is one of the more interesting streaming options for Week 1 against Detroit. He settled in after taking over last season, throwing for 2,256 yards, 10 touchdowns and five interceptions across nine starts. The finish was especially encouraging. Over his final five games, Shough threw for 1,316 yards and five touchdowns while adding 135 yards and three scores on the ground. Detroit gave up 4,027 passing yards and 31 passing touchdowns in 2025, and starting safeties Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph will both miss the opener. That gives Shough a favorable spot with Chris Olave leading the passing game, even with rookie Jordyn Tyson on injured reserve. RotoBaller has Shough at QB16 for Week 1. He is not a locked-in QB1, but managers looking for a streamer can use him with real top-12 upside if this game turns into a shootout.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Leaves Fantasy Managers Plenty to Believe In
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough made a pretty convincing case for himself before his rookie season ended. Over his final five games, Shough completed 69.9% of his passes for 1,316 yards, five touchdowns and only two interceptions while New Orleans went 4-1. He gave fantasy managers something on the ground too, adding 135 rushing yards and three more scores during that stretch. It was enough to earn him NFL Offensive Rookie of the Month honors for December and January. Shough now enters Year 2 without a quarterback competition and with Chris Olave coming off the best season of his career. First-round receiver Jordyn Tyson will miss the beginning of the year on injured reserve, so the supporting cast isn't completely intact. Still, Shough's finish is difficult to brush aside as one good game or a short hot streak. If that late-season version sticks around, he could move well beyond being viewed as just another matchup-dependent fantasy quarterback.

metadata.title: Tyler Shough Belongs in the Week 1 Streaming Conversation
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough is worth considering if you're already looking for a Week 1 streamer. He settled in once New Orleans gave him the job last season, throwing for 2,256 yards, 10 touchdowns and five interceptions across nine starts while adding another 174 yards and three scores on the ground. That little bit of rushing helps here. Shough will go into 2026 as the starter, with Chris Olave still leading the receiver room, although rookie Jordyn Tyson will miss the beginning of the season on injured reserve. The matchup sends him to Detroit on Sunday, and the current Week 1 rankings have Shough at QB16 despite being rostered in only 43% of Yahoo leagues. He still makes the most sense in 14-team leagues or for managers who don't love their current starter, but this isn't just a desperation QB2. Shough can actually be used right away.
